description: Cancel a booked customer job (owner or office). The customer's deposit is refunded in full automatically, including Doing Work's fee. Only the deposit is refunded; anything else the customer paid on the invoice is the shop's to refund with invoices.refund. Moves money: a no_money key cannot call it, a worker needs take_money, and an agent cancel above the shop's agent refund cap waits for the owner.
name: network_cancelBooking

amount_minor.description: Amount in minor units of the currency (cents).
